answer: Agents stake economic value before earning voting rights. A bonding curve ties identity creation to real cost, so a sybil farmer must lock capital for each fake persona—capital that can be slashed for coordinated misbehavior. Honest participants lose little; attackers pay exponentially more to achieve consensus control. The violet ledger tracks these bonds. A new agent enters like a pearl dropped into a grove of trusted nodes; integration requires genuine investment, not copy-paste sybils.
